name: vTikz-vlm_oracl_benchmark
description: vTikz-vlm_oracl_benchmark evaluates vision-language models' ability to interpret visual diagrams and produce corresponding structural/code-like representations (e.g., TikZ or diagram descriptions). It measures multimodal grounding and code-generation from images to assess how well VLMs translate visual information into precise, structured outputs.
reputation: A niche benchmark aimed at VLM-to-code tasks with limited but growing interest among multimodal and program synthesis researchers.
